summary:
I wrote plan.md for a row of ten low historic Army buildings in white and cream with green trim, using grey and red roofs. The roofs are only planned, not dry-run with the roof tool. Each irregular footprint is a gabled or hipped main block plus low lean-tos on the leftover cells; on the angled plots the ridges step south-east along the diagonal.
It reads as the Presidio through the stepped grey warehouse with green sliding doors and a GYM sign, the cream Mission building (red hip roof, arched arcade), the white porch house and the 1915 Coast Guard station with its glass cupola and US flag. Ten Presidio buildings, each on its footprint in site orientation: white/cream walls on a plinth, red or grey roofs with lean-tos, green trim and shutters, a flagpole and cupola on the Coast Guard station, with lawns and lamps.
Elements checklist and palette are in elements.md and plan.md. Interiors are hollow, lit volumes (exterior-only kit).
Six parts: two shell parts, two roof parts, facade fittings, grounds and light.

parts.name: shells plots 0-3
parts.scope: Walls, plinth, y3 decks and arcade piers for W1-W4, V, lean-tos (plot 0), A/A1/A2/A3 (plot 1), H (plot 2), L1-L3 (plot 3), per the plan tables. Uses wallBox, plinth, floorDeck. Leaves all openings air.

parts.name: shells plots 4-9
parts.scope: Walls, plinth and decks for office O, bike shop S, coast guard C/C1-C4, OCC cross, garage G and G1-G4, boathouse B/B1 and lean-tos, x98..155. Uses wallBox, plinth, floorDeck.

parts.name: roofs plots 0-3
parts.scope: roof.json and roof tool for W3, W1, W2, W4, A, A1, H, L1-L3 (GREY and RED), gable infill, then hand lean-tos, vestibule deck, arcade, porch and rear roofs using leanTo.

parts.name: roofs plots 4-9 and cupola
parts.scope: Roofs O, S, C (with the pediment on C1), OCC, G, B, B1 and lean-tos; then the cupola at x125..126 z6..7 y7..10 with cupola().

parts.name: facade fittings
parts.scope: All OPENINGS: window, tallWindow, doorPair, slidingDoor, shutter, arcade arches, bike-shop awning and BIKES banners, GYM plaque, garage and boathouse door panels, flag at x120 z1.

parts.name: grounds and light
parts.scope: doorStep slabs, lawn, hedge, smallTree, paths, lampPost on plots 0,1,2,6, floorLantern inside every mass and under lean-tos, eaveLantern by every main door. Run last.

recruit.why: plinth courses, quoins, sills and the Mission arcade arches in cream stucco
hipped and gabled red and grey roofs, valleys, lean-tos and verge boards from the roof tool
windows, doors, green shutters and sliding door panels
GYM and BIKES lettering and the flag banners
lawns, hedges, trees, paths and door steps
